rows.quote: The replication cohorts included data from the EBI (25), with 56,087 cases and 428,511 controls, and the UK Biobank (27), with 53,598 cases and 409,335 controls (Figure 1, Supplementary Table 2).
rows.dataset_named_in_source: the EBI (25), with 56,087 cases and 428,511 controls
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the EBI asthma data (56,087 cases, 428,511 controls) to reference 25 (Donertas 2021, Nat Aging), a GWAS with no dictionary row; the Study design sentence cites (25, 26) after EBI, and reference 26 alone cannot carry a code there because two records are cited for the one dataset.

rows.quote: The discovery cohort was sourced from FinnGen Release 10 (24), published in December 2023, comprising 5,026 asthma cases and 225,703 controls.
rows.coder_note: "FinnGen Release 10" names release R10 (rule A); the endpoint counts (5,026 + 225,703 = 230,729, given again in the results) are endpoint-specific and conflict with nothing (rule H).

rows.value: MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)
rows.quote: Genes that met significance thresholds were further validated in replication cohorts from the European Bioinformatics Institute (EBI) (25, 26) and the UK Biobank (26, 27), including subgroup analyses for childhood-onset and adult-onset asthma.
rows.reference_quote: Mitchell R, Elsworth BL, Raistrick CA, Paternoster L, Hemani G, Gaunt TR. MRC IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline version 2. Bristol: University of Bristol; (2019). doi: 10.5523/BRIS.PNOAT8CXO0U52P6YNFAEKEIGI
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the UK Biobank replication data to references 26 and 27; reference 26 (MRC IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline version 2, DOI 10.5523/bris.pnoat8cxo0u52p6ynfaekeigi) is the source of one dictionary row, and reference 27 (Bycroft 2018) is the general cohort description. The row is outside the listed candidates. The asthma counts (53,598 + 409,335 = 462,933) are phenotype-specific and identify no other release (rule H). For the checker: the Outcome data sentence cites (27) alone for UK Biobank, and reference 26 is also cited after EBI.
